title: Barcelona to the Costa Brava
structure: W Barcelona (3 nights) → Costa Brava (2 nights) → Le Méridien Barcelona (1 night + departure)

days.label: Tue Aug 11
days.theme: Arrival, W Barcelona, Gothic Quarter & El Born + Flamenco

events.title: Arrive at BCN Airport
events.details: Barcelona-El Prat Airport. Allow 60–90 minutes for immigration, baggage claim, and leaving the terminal.

events.title: Taxi to W Barcelona
events.details: Iconic sail-shaped hotel on the waterfront at the southern tip of Barceloneta beach.

events.title: Arrive at W Barcelona
events.details: Drop luggage if room not ready. Do not book any timed attraction for the first morning.

events.title: W Barcelona + Beachfront Walk
events.details: Walk along Sant Sebastià Beach and Barceloneta promenade. Light snack or drink. A relaxed first look at Barcelona.

events.title: Lunch in Barceloneta
events.details: Historic fishing neighborhood turned seafood dining hub. Croquetas, pan con tomate, grilled fish, tapas, rice dishes.

events.title: Gothic Quarter
events.details: Barcelona's medieval heart. Roman ruins, narrow stone alleys, 14th-century cathedral. Route: Plaça Reial → Carrer del Call → Plaça Sant Jaume → Cathedral → Pont del Bisbe → Temple of Augustus.

events.title: El Born
events.details: Trendy medieval quarter with boutiques, galleries, and Santa Maria del Mar — Barcelona's most beautiful Gothic church. Walk Passeig del Born and Carrer de Montcada.

events.title: Picasso Museum
events.details: Explore the extensive collection of Pablo Picasso's early works, housed in five medieval palaces in the heart of El Born. Book tickets in advance to save time. Allow 1.5 hours for the visit.

events.title: Arrive at Flamenco Show
events.details: Arrive 15-30 minutes before the show starts to find your seats and settle in. Book tickets in advance!

events.title: Flamenco Show
events.details: Experience the passion of a live flamenco performance. Consider venues like Tablao Flamenco Cordobes (La Rambla), Palau Dalmases (El Born), or Tablao de Carmen (Poble Espanyol, requires taxi).

events.title: Dinner in El Born
events.details: Enjoy a tapas-focused dinner in El Born after the flamenco show. Many venues offer dinner & show packages, or you can dine separately.

events.title: Port Vell + Return to W
events.details: Barcelona's old port — yachts, illuminated Columbus monument, waterfront promenade. Then taxi back to the W after the show.

days.label: Wed Aug 12
days.theme: Sagrada Família, Passeig de Gràcia, Casa Batlló & Gràcia

events.title: Breakfast at W Barcelona
events.details: Hotel breakfast with Mediterranean sea views.

events.title: Sagrada Família
events.details: Gaudí's unfinished masterpiece — one of the most visited buildings on Earth. Soaring nave, forest-like columns, extraordinary stained glass. Allow 2 hours.

events.title: Avinguda de Gaudí
events.details: Tree-lined pedestrian boulevard connecting Sagrada Família to Hospital de Sant Pau. Beautiful Art Nouveau hospital exterior. Coffee stop.

events.title: Passeig de Gràcia
events.details: Barcelona's grandest boulevard. Luxury shopping, modernista architecture, Casa Milà (La Pedrera) exterior.

events.title: Lunch in Eixample
events.details: Barcelona's grid-plan neighbourhood. Wide sidewalk terraces, modernista buildings, excellent restaurant density.

events.title: W Barcelona — Pool & Rest
events.details: Long afternoon break before the evening concert. Swim, nap, get ready for Magical Nights.

events.title: Casa Batlló — Magical Nights
events.details: Gold experience: rooftop concert at sunset inside Gaudí's masterpiece. Passeig de Gràcia, 43. Arrive a bit early to explore the building before the show.

events.title: Post-Magic Night Drink / Stroll
events.details: Enjoy a final drink on Passeig de Gràcia or a leisurely stroll back to the W Barcelona, soaking in the evening atmosphere.

events.title: Return to W Barcelona
events.details: Taxi back to the hotel after a magical evening.

days.label: Thu Aug 13
days.theme: Park Güell, Montjuïc, W Beach Afternoon & Barceloneta Evening

events.title: Breakfast at W
events.details: Last morning at the W before Costa Brava tomorrow.

events.title: Gràcia Coffee & Stroll
events.details: Enjoy a relaxed morning coffee and pastry in the charming Gràcia neighborhood before heading to Park Güell.

events.title: Park Güell
events.details: Monumental Zone, Hypostyle Room, serpentine mosaic bench, Gaudí structures, city viewpoints. ~90 minutes. Entry at 12:30, valid for 30 minutes after.

events.title: Lunch near Park Güell / Gràcia
events.details: Grab a casual lunch in the area after your visit to the park.

events.title: Montjuïc
events.details: Hilltop with panoramic Barcelona views — MNAC palace, 1992 Olympic stadium, Jardins de Mossèn Costa, Mirador del Migdia. Don't try to walk the entire hill.

events.title: W Barcelona Beach / Pool Afternoon
events.details: Proper chunk of afternoon enjoying the hotel: infinity pool, beach access, spa, cocktails at WET deck. Transition from city sightseeing toward coastal vacation.

events.title: Barceloneta Walk
events.details: Walk from the W along the beachfront promenade through the old fishing neighbourhood. Tapas bars, local life, sunset views.

events.title: Dinner in Barceloneta
events.details: Enjoy a delicious dinner in the vibrant Barceloneta neighborhood. Plenty of options for tapas, paella, or other Mediterranean dishes beyond just seafood.

events.title: Walk Back to W
events.details: Beachfront promenade back to the hotel along the illuminated waterfront. Last night at the W.

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Final breakfast at the W with sea views.

events.title: Checkout from W Barcelona
events.details: Collect luggage and prepare to depart the waterfront.

events.title: Pick Up Rental Car
events.details: Arrange pickup location to avoid driving through central Barcelona. Load luggage and head north.

events.title: Drive to Begur
events.details: ~1.5–2 hours via AP-7 motorway through the Catalan countryside to the Costa Brava coast.

events.title: Begur Arrival
events.details: Hilltop medieval town with a ruined castle, colourful colonial-era houses, and views across the Empordà plain to the sea.

events.title: Aiguablava
events.details: One of the Costa Brava's finest coves — crystal-clear turquoise water, pine-fringed cliffs, fine sand. Swimming, snorkeling, kayaking, paddleboarding.

events.title: Coastal Lunch
events.details: Long Mediterranean lunch at a terrace overlooking the water. Fresh fish, local wines, anchovies, grilled prawns.

events.title: Hotel / Siesta
events.details: Check in properly to the Gran Hotel Reymar. Shower, rest, enjoy the quieter pace.

events.title: Begur Old Town
events.details: Explore the medieval streets as the temperature drops. Walk up to Begur Castle for 360° views across the Empordà to the Pyrenees and Mediterranean.

events.title: Dinner in Begur
events.details: Dinner in one of the village squares. Catalan cuisine, grilled meats, local Empordà wines.

days.label: Sat Aug 15
days.theme: Calella de Palafrugell, Camí de Ronda, Llafranc, Pals & Peratallada

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: Morning meal at the Gran Hotel Reymar before a full coastal day.

events.title: Calella de Palafrugell
events.details: Postcard-perfect fishing village — whitewashed houses with blue shutters, small pebbly beaches, Port Bo arcades. The classic Costa Brava image.

events.title: Camí de Ronda
events.details: Ancient coastal footpath carved into the cliffs. Walk the Calella → Llafranc section: pine-shaded trails, turquoise coves, rocky headlands. One of the trip's top experiences.

events.title: Llafranc
events.details: Elegant crescent beach with a marina, seafront cafés, and the Far de Sant Sebastià lighthouse on the headland above.

events.title: Long Seafood Lunch
events.details: Proper coastal feast: local anchovies, gambas, suquet de peix, arròs negre, fideuà. Eat with views of the Mediterranean.

events.title: Swim
events.details: Return to the water at Llafranc or a nearby cove. Let lunch settle. No rushing to the car.

events.title: Pals
events.details: Perfectly preserved medieval hilltop village — 10th-century Romanesque tower, cobblestone streets, stone arches, panoramic rice-field views.

events.title: Peratallada
events.details: One of Catalonia's best-preserved medieval villages. Honey-coloured stone, moat-carved streets, arched passageways. Stunning in golden-hour light.

events.title: Dinner
events.details: Eat in Peratallada's atmospheric main square, or drive back to Begur. Catalan country cooking at its best.

days.label: Sun Aug 16
days.theme: Costa Brava → Le Méridien, Relaxed Final Barcelona Day

events.title: Breakfast in Costa Brava
events.details: Final morning at the Gran Hotel Reymar. Enjoy the quiet before heading back to the city.

events.title: Leave for Barcelona
events.details: Drive south on AP-7. ~1.5–2 hours back to the city.

events.title: Return Rental Car + Le Méridien
events.details: Drop the car. Le Méridien sits directly on La Rambla — walk into Gothic Quarter, Plaça Catalunya, and Passeig de Gràcia in minutes.

events.title: Central Barcelona Walk
events.details: Stroll from the hotel into the heart of the city: Plaça Catalunya → La Rambla → Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial. Intentionally easy.

events.title: Lunch
events.details: Central Barcelona lunch — plenty of options within 5 minutes of Le Méridien.

events.title: Le Méridien Break
events.details: Relax at the hotel. Organize bags for tomorrow's departure. Use the lounge.

events.title: Flexible Final Barcelona Block
events.details: Choose what you loved most: A) Passeig de Gràcia shopping, B) El Born boutiques, C) Gothic Quarter revisit, D) Palau de la Música Catalana, E) Port Vell sunset. Skip another beach afternoon.

events.title: Farewell Dinner
events.details: Make this the best or most celebratory dinner of the entire trip. Dress up, splurge, toast to the week.

events.title: Final Barcelona Walk
events.details: Walk back through the illuminated Gothic Quarter and La Rambla to Le Méridien.

events.title: Breakfast
events.details: No rush. Final morning in Barcelona at the hotel.

events.title: Final Walk
events.details: Last stroll through Barcelona. Option A: Gothic Quarter → Plaça Reial → La Rambla. Option B: Plaça Catalunya → Passeig de Gràcia. Coffee, pastries, souvenirs, photos.

events.title: Back to Le Méridien
events.details: Return to the hotel. Finish packing, collect luggage, prepare for checkout.

events.title: Checkout / Airport Transfer
events.details: Taxi to Barcelona-El Prat Airport. Target arrival ~3 hours before international departure.
